description: This file defines the SiloConnectionOptions class which implements silo networking configuration options. It provides methods to configure outbound and inbound silo connections and inbound gateway connections, utilizing delegates and an inner interface for configuration.

classes.name: SiloConnectionOptions
classes.description: A class that implements silo networking options and configuration methods.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloOutboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo outbound connections via delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureSiloInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from other silos.

methods.name: ConfigureGatewayInboundConnection
methods.description: Configures silo inbound connections from clients.
